seo.youtube_title: Seoul's Coolest Neighborhood Nobody Talks About

cuts.narration: Forget Gangnam. THIS is where Seoul truly comes alive — Seongsu-dong, the Brooklyn of Korea.

cuts.narration: Once Seoul's industrial heartland — shoe factories, printing presses, metalworks. Now? The most creative district in Asia.

title_overlay.sub: From factories to Seoul's creative capital

cuts.scene_description: 서울숲 전경 — 도심 속 광활한 녹지와 한강 뷰
cuts.narration: Right next door — Seoul Forest. 1.2 million square meters of pure nature, smack in the middle of the city.

cuts.narration: The secret that shocks every tourist — you can feed DEER in the middle of Seoul. Yes, actual deer.

cuts.narration: Seongsu has a secret identity — Korea's shoemaking capital for 60 years. Watch masters craft leather by hand.

cuts.narration: Seoul's most Instagrammable cafes are ALL here. Rooftop views, Han River panoramas — coffee has never looked this good.
